title: Spectra Vandal
extract:
The Spectra Vandal is the Vandal variant of the  Spectra laser beam sidearm, sporting increased damage, critical chance and status chance, magazine size, max ammo capacity, and faster reload speed. It was released in Update 25.0 (2019-05-22) along with Operation: Hostile Mergers.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Damage ramps up from 25% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 25% over 2 seconds.
Innate 0.5 meter Punch Through.
Can use the Spectra-exclusive  Sequence Burn mod.
Advantages over other Secondary Held Pistol weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Pinpoint accuracy.
 Magnum Force's accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon.
Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high crit chance (20.00%)
Above average burst DPS (316.8)
Above average sustained DPS (290.64)
Very high magazine size (80)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Very high accuracy (0.00° to 0.00°)
Very high reload speed (1.20 s)
Very high ammo max (400)
Very high fire rate (12.00 attacks/sec)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.45x))
Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary Held Pistol weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Limited range of 22 meters, but  Ruinous Extension and  Sequence Burn can be equipped to extend the maximum range.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average status chance (28.00%)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Spectra Vandal (Normal Attack), compared to  Spectra (Normal Attack):
Higher base damage per projectile (22.00 vs. 18.00)
Higher  Puncture damage ( 9.24 vs.  7.56)
Higher  Slash damage ( 12.76 vs.  10.44)
Higher total damage (22 vs. 18)
Higher base critical chance (20.00% vs. 14.00%)
Higher base status chance (28.00% vs. 22.00%)

Higher burst DPS (316.8 vs. 246.24)
Higher sustained DPS (290.64 vs. 208.67)
Larger magazine (80 vs. 60)
More shots per magazine (160 vs. 120)

Faster reload time (1.20 s vs. 1.80 s)

Acquisition
This weapon was awarded for earning 1,000 points in a single Endurance Disruption Mission in Operation: Hostile Mergers, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.
This weapon's blueprint and components are now obtained from Veil Proxima Grineer-controlled territory Abandoned Derelicts in Empyrean missions. All parts can be traded between players.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
